page: Microsoft Azure E20s_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Compute resources comprise 20 dedicated virtual CPUs backed by 10 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU configuration features 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache, with hardware instruction support for AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AES-NI, and SHA extensions. Memory capacity is provisioned at 160.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. No local disk storage or discrete GPUs are bundled with this instance type, requiring external Premium Storage volumes for operational data needs.

Benchmark results place the instance primarily in the middle 50th percentile across compute and memory operations. The instance registered a Geekbench single-core score of 1,431.0 and a multi-core score of 9,851.0, accompanied by a PassMark CPU score of 18,995.2 and multi-core stress-ng throughput of 18,643.24. Memory throughput reached 114.17 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 61.14 GB/sec for uncached large-block writes, with cached small-block reads achieving 863.89 GB/sec. In database-centric tests, the instance demonstrated 6,693.11 PassMark database operations and sustained 17.08 million Redis SET operations per second. In single-threaded compression benchmarks, performance was comparatively lower, recording 8.78 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression, falling into the bottom 25th percentile.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E20s_v4 delivers balanced returns for workloads whose primary constraint is memory capacity rather than raw compute frequency. Because it lacks included local NVMe disks, storage overhead relies on remote disk attachments, which should be factored into infrastructure resource planning. The high memory-to-core balance makes this virtual machine appropriate for in-memory caching systems, mid-to-large relational database engines, enterprise analytics processing, and enterprise application runtimes requiring substantial RAM.
description: Microsoft Azure E20s_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 20 dedicated vCPUs and 10 physical cores driven by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor at 2.8 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture with 48 MB of L3 cache, it includes hardware support for AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerations. The instance provides 160.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, with no bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware. In synthetic benchmarks, it demonstrates consistent mid-tier performance, producing a PassMark CPU score of 18,995.2, an uncached memory read bandwidth of 114.17 GB/sec, and 17.08 million Redis SET operations per second, though single-threaded bzip3 decompression rates rank in the lower quartile. The E20s_v4 delivers balanced efficiency for memory-intensive enterprise tasks, in-memory caches, relational database systems, and data analytics pipelines relying on network-attached storage.
